name: listAppend
description: Concatenates a list or element to a list.
syntax: listAppend( string list, string value, [string delimiters], [boolean includeEmptyFields] )

params.name: delimiters
params.description:
Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

If this string contains more than one character, only the first character is used.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if false it cleans up empty fields.
